protocol.selection: mean best validation weighted-MSE across grids
protocol.stability_rule: a candidate with a non-finite validation loss on any grid is disqualified; the leading candidate must also reproduce at the tie seed before it can be frozen; if no candidate survives at one learning rate the grid is re-scored at the other
protocol.notes: arma_gnn was re-swept after its edge weight was made non-negative (see docs/Model_configurations.md); the superseded sweep of the earlier ARMA layer is kept in results_a/arma_gnn and results_a/arma_stability.
